Deaths and populations by Land, Germany

Source: R/data-gbe.R
de_deaths.Rd

Deaths by year (1998-2024), Land, sex, age group and ICD-10 chapter, and populations on 31 December (1997-2024) by Land, sex and single year of age. The vignette "Differences between the German Laender" reads them with mt_data() and prepares them with mt_as_exposure(), mt_regroup(), mt_subset() and mt_fill_suppressed().

Usage

de_deaths

de_population

de_cause_groups

Format

de_deaths: a data frame with columns year, region, sex ("male", "female"), age, cause, deaths. de_population: a data frame with columns year (population on 31 December), region, sex, age ("unter 1 Jahr", single years, "90 Jahre und mehr"), population. de_cause_groups: a named list of chapter codes.

An object of class data.frame with 81536 rows and 5 columns.

An object of class list of length 7.

Source

Deaths: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Todesursachenstatistik, table "Sterbefaelle, Sterbeziffern (ab 1998)" of the Gesundheitsberichterstattung des Bundes, https://www.gbe-bund.de, retrieved 13 October 2026. Population: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Genesis-Online, table 12411-0013, retrieved 13 October 2026. Datenlizenz Deutschland - Namensnennung - Version 2.0 (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0); reshaped, suppressed cells kept as missing (own processing, data-raw/de_data.R).

Details

de_deaths holds the national total (region = "Deutschland") and the 16 Laender, 18 age groups (column age: "Unter 1 Jahr", "1 Jahr bis unter 15 Jahre", 5-year groups, "90 Jahre und aelter" with umlaut), all causes (cause = "all") and the 18 ICD-10 chapters of the source table (codes such as "C00-D48"; the labels are in attribute "cause_labels"). Deaths that the source suppresses for confidentiality (".") are NA: 13% of the cells, mostly rare chapters in small Laender; 33 all-cause cells (Bremen, Saarland, Hamburg, Sachsen-Anhalt, ages 1-34). Deaths from pregnancy and childbirth in men ("X", not applicable) are 0. The causes add up to all causes and the Laender to Germany wherever all cells are published; 2025 is left out because its chapters did not add up. Injuries and poisonings (S00-T98) are the chapter of external causes.

de_cause_groups lists cause groups for cause-specific analyses at ages 50 and over: neoplasms, diseases of the circulatory, respiratory and digestive systems, mental and nervous system disorders combined (dementia is coded in both chapters), endocrine diseases and external causes; the remaining chapters form "rest" with mt_group_levels().

Examples

head(de_deaths)
#>   year            region    sex          age   cause deaths
#> 1 1998 Baden-Württemberg female Unter 1 Jahr A00-B99     NA
#> 2 1998 Baden-Württemberg female Unter 1 Jahr C00-D48      0
#> 3 1998 Baden-Württemberg female Unter 1 Jahr D50-D90      0
#> 4 1998 Baden-Württemberg female Unter 1 Jahr E00-E90      4
#> 5 1998 Baden-Württemberg female Unter 1 Jahr F00-F99      0
#> 6 1998 Baden-Württemberg female Unter 1 Jahr G00-H95     NA
x <- mt_data(deaths = subset(de_deaths, cause == "all" & year >= 2018),
             population = subset(de_population, year >= 2017),
             by = c("region", "sex"))
#> Warning: 10 missing deaths value(s) left out; suppressed counts can be estimated with mt_fill_suppressed().
x <- mt_as_exposure(x, type = "dec31")
x
#> <mt_data> 34 strata by region, sex, omega = 110
#>   deaths     mixed widths (1,5,14) 0-89, 90+; periods 2018-2024 (width 1); 4274 cells
#>   exposure   single years 0-89, 90+; periods 2018-2024 (width 1); 20384 cells
#>   population single years 0-89, 90+; periods 2017-2024 (width 1); 23296 cells
#>   grid       <mt_axis: age, 91 intervals> 0 1 2 3 ... 88 89 90+
#>              <mt_axis: period, 7 intervals> 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024
